title: Research CatalystX9 LabNotebookSOP

stats.done_summary: Rebuilt the Catalyst‑X9 workflow to match the actual notebook excerpt in `data/lab_notebook_x9.txt` (reactor synthesis + centrifugation/ether wash). Implemented robust parsing + QA in `code/generate_assets.py`, created `outputs/summary.json`, `outputs/events.csv`, and `outputs/completeness.csv`, and generated four required PNG figures under `report/images/` (timeline, temperature-profile consistency check, completeness assessment, centrifugation settings). Overwrote `synthesis_sop.md` as a night‑shift executable SOP with checklists, CPPs, deviation triggers, and a safe hold-state due to the missing page. Wrote an academic-style report with methodology/results/discussion and figure references to `report/report.md`.
